title: Salt, Spices, Condiments and Related Products

official_sources.title: Chapter 2.9 — Salt, Spices, Condiments and Related Products, Version 4 (01.08.2025)
View all FSSAI Standardized Food Products

regulatory_notes: The current consolidated Chapter 2.9 is Version 4 dated 01.08.2025 and runs through 2.9.45.
For standards 2.9.1 to 2.9.29, the chapter expressly requires compliance with Table 3 of Appendix B microbiological requirements.
The inorganic portion of extraneous matter, where extraneous matter is prescribed, shall not exceed 2% by weight of total extraneous matter.

Current 2025 stakeholder-agenda proposals/final-draft items concerning Juniper Berries, Refined Iodised Salt, Garam Masala and Dried Peppermint are not loaded as operative standards unless incorporated into the current consolidated regulation.
Harrisa (Red Hot Pepper Paste) exists in the FoSCoS catalogue but no matching Chapter 2.9 standard is present in the current consolidated Chapter 2.9; PMSV therefore leaves it at base-profile level.

common_rules.text: Where extraneous matter is prescribed, inorganic extraneous matter such as dust, dirt, stones and lumps of earth shall not exceed 2% by weight of total extraneous matter.
Comply with Table 3 of Appendix B.
Food additives apply only where permitted by the relevant product standard and Appendix A.
Applicable products shall comply with current FSSAI Contaminants, Toxins and Residues requirements.

Current Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 apply. Historical references in older consolidated text to the former Packaging and Labelling Regulations are not treated as the current instrument.
